text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Hanshin Juvenile<n>Fillies, Mejiro
Dober surprises<n>herself with how calm she is,
despite<n>it being her first G1 race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If she wants to fulfill her promise to<n>Mejiro Bright,
she'll need to do well<n>in this race and gain the
confidence to<n>keep moving forward. Determined,
she heads to the track.
